proposals.quote: As further evidence of working with local businesses, Hard Rock Metropolitan Park has committed $25 million to developing and implementing a small business lending program. This program will assist small businesses in receiving loans and reducing lender risk, ultimately maximizing the potential for success for small businesses in the surrounding communities.

The Board views HRMP’s $25 million commitment to a small-business lender program - supporting MWBE firms - and its partnership with McKissack & McKissack, expected to be part of the ownership group, as a strength.⁸
We also provide technical assistance to help businesses gain MWBE certification and are backing this work with a $25 million MWBE lending program.

We have already launched MWBE capacity-building efforts, including two contracting sessions at Citi Field, a $25 million lending program to expand capital access, and robust prequalification processes.
